title: C# Constructors
description: A constructor is a special method that is used to initialize objects.

challenges.title: Default Constructor
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Dog' with a public string 'Name'. Use a constructor to set Name to 'Buddy'. In Main, print 'dog.Name'.

challenges.title: Parameter Constructor
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Person' with string 'Name'. Create a constructor that takes a string 'n' and sets Name to 'n'. Create a 'Person' with 'Aris' and print Name.
